bundles.buyer_profile: ticketing platforms, venue/promoter service operators, and event-tech partners with payout/reporting/export workflows
common_objections: Native platform reporting already reconciles settlements.
Independent QA sounds like a replacement or audit accusation.
The fixed scope may be too large for a small organizer.
bundles.name: Event Ticketing Settlement QA
bundles.objection_response: Position as bounded second-source export QA; make no defect claim; qualify economics before proposing the full fixed scope.
qualification_questions: Can the buyer supply one complete closed-period ticket/refund export and settlement statement without credentials?
Is scope one legal entity, one ticketing/promoter account, one currency, and <=92 closed days?
Is the need independent second-source QA rather than platform replacement or payment mutation?

bundles.buyer_profile: grant-management platforms, grant-administration consultancies, public-sector/nonprofit delivery partners
common_objections: The grant platform already tracks compliance and reporting.
A second-source packet could duplicate program staff review.
Sponsor rules are too program-specific for a generic control.
bundles.name: Grant Drawdown & Subrecipient Evidence QA
bundles.objection_response: Keep sponsor interpretation with the buyer; use the product only for deterministic evidence completeness, arithmetic, provenance and owner-review exceptions.
qualification_questions: Can the owner provide complete retained normalized generations for one award and closed period?
Does the desired work stop at evidence QA and owner review rather than allowability/legal/accounting conclusions?
Can sponsor/portal submission and certification remain with the buyer or prime?

bundles.buyer_profile: systems integrators, digital engineering firms, MSPs, implementation PMOs and buyer-side transformation offices
common_objections: PMO and finance already manage milestones and changes.
The desk could become a contract-interpretation function.
Implementation evidence varies too much across vendors.
disqualifiers: asks us to accept work or approve changes/invoices
bundles.name: Implementation SOW / Milestone Acceptance Control
bundles.objection_response: Bind only owner-normalized evidence and explicit decisions; do not interpret prose or replace PMO, legal, procurement, or accounts payable authority.
qualification_questions: Is there a bounded implementation portfolio with explicit milestone and change-order evidence?
Can acceptance authority stay with the contracting parties while the desk only checks evidence consistency?
Can the buyer provide invoice/credit evidence without production-system credentials?

authority_exclusions: no provider access, recovery, savings or revenue claim
bundles.buyer_profile: independent and boutique hotel managers, owner-operators, and small hotel-management platforms
common_objections: PMS/accounting controls already cover comps and house use.
The control is too narrow compared with overall hotel performance.
A small portfolio may not justify a separate product.
disqualifiers: requires guest/employee identity in durable packet
scope exceeds one property/currency without rescope
bundles.name: Hospitality Comp / House-Use Evidence Control
bundles.objection_response: Use one-property, ten-business-day second-source evidence review to test whether any owner-review value exists; stop if it does not.
qualification_questions: Can the buyer supply one property buyer-declared redacted offline export without PMS credentials?
Is one currency and <=10,000 stay rows sufficient for the pilot?
Is the desired outcome owner-review evidence hygiene rather than fraud/personnel/accounting conclusions?

bundles.buyer_profile: telecom-expense-management providers, managed mobility firms, MSPs, carriers and enterprise telecom operations
common_objections: TEM platforms already automate invoice validation.
Carrier data may be too inconsistent for a bounded packet.
A $4.5k review may not justify another vendor.
disqualifiers: requires us to dispute invoices or request credits
bundles.name: Telecom Invoice & Inventory Reconciliation
bundles.objection_response: CURRENTLY HOLD. No sales action until the source carrier merges; later position only as bounded independent evidence reconciliation.
qualification_questions: Do not qualify externally until the current product carrier is merged and independently reverified.
After merge, can a buyer supply one provider/period with bounded service and invoice-row counts?
Can all carrier disputes, credits, service changes and payment actions remain with the buyer?

global_outbound_rule: Targets are research-only. Before any external contact: exact org+route+purpose Slack/Gmail census, Muse single-writer election, immediate post-election recensus, at most one selected send; provider-SENT => hard DNR until genuine inbound.

products.authority_ceiling: offline owner-review reconciliation only; no platform/API/login, refund/payout/payment/ledger mutation, contract/legal/tax conclusion, savings/cash/revenue assertion, or external-send authority
products.name: Event Ticketing & Promoter Settlement Reconciliation Desk
products.scope: one legal entity + one ticketing/promoter account + one currency + one fully closed period <=92 days; owner-supplied retained exports only

products.name: Grant / Subrecipient Drawdown & Match Evidence Workspace
products.scope: one owner-normalized award generation + complete retained expense/evidence/subrecipient/match/prior-draw generations; closed-period evidence review

products.authority_ceiling: owner-review commercial control only; no SOW acceptance/signature, change/invoice approval, buyer/vendor contact, ERP/CRM/payment mutation, legal/accounting conclusion, savings/receivable/revenue assertion, or external-send authority
products.name: Software Implementation SOW / Milestone / Change-Order Commercial Control Desk
products.scope: bounded implementation portfolio using owner-normalized SOW, milestone delivery/acceptance, change-order, invoice-line and credit evidence

products.authority_ceiling: offline owner-review only; no PMS/CRS/OTA/provider login or mutation, guest/employee/vendor contact, payment/funds action, fraud/personnel/legal/accounting conclusion, savings/cash/revenue assertion, deployment, or outbound authority
products.name: CompControl Paid Pilot

state_model.CONCEPT: idea/spec only; must never be represented as delivered
state_model.MERGED_DELIVERABLE: provider-verifiable merged source; may be packaged commercially but remains proposed until accepted
state_model.OPEN_NEAR_SHIP: not merged or current gates unresolved; must never be treated as outreach-ready
